style: Editorial lifestyle photograph for Maison Maho, a travel-wear and lifestyle brand. High summer, bright clear morning sunlight, crisp shadows, fresh airy palette of white, ivory, sand, sea blue, terracotta and olive. Shot on 35mm film, shallow depth of field, natural skin, candid and unposed. Mediterranean coastal setting. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no borders.

images.prompt: A woman in her thirties walks mid-stride along a sunlit whitewashed street in a seaside village, wearing a sleeveless ivory linen midi dress and flat leather sandals and carrying a tan leather weekender bag, blue sea glimpsed at the end of the street. Full body, subject centered, room around her on both sides.
Close portrait of a woman with round tortoiseshell sunglasses and a white linen shirt, leaning on a harbour wall with bright turquoise sea softly out of focus behind her. Face centered in the frame.

A woman in a white linen shirt knotted at the waist over wide sand linen trousers, a straw hat in one hand, standing in front of a sunlit whitewashed wall, three-quarter view, looking off frame. Centered, head to knees.
A man in a sea blue short-sleeved linen shirt, white tee and stone cotton shorts, hands in pockets, standing in front of a sunlit stone archway with bougainvillea. Centered, head to knees.

Flat lay on white linen: a tan leather crossbody bag, tortoiseshell sunglasses, a slim steel watch and a woven straw hat, arranged with space between them. Overhead view, bright direct sunlight with crisp shadows.

A bedroom corner with a bed in crisp white linen sheets, a folded sea blue cotton throw at the foot, a terracotta vase with fresh olive branches on a wooden side table and a stack of three books. Bright morning sun through open shutters.

Inside a small tailoring atelier: a long wooden table with rolls of white and sand linen, a tailor's hands pinning the collar of a white shirt on a dress form, scissors and chalk beside them. Bright window light, open window with a slice of blue sky.
Three friends in white and sand linen shirts and dresses laughing on a rooftop terrace at midday, whitewashed houses and the blue sea out of focus behind them. Group centered, wide frame.
Close-up texture study of a folded white linen shirt and a sea blue cotton shirt on a wooden bench, bright direct sunlight with crisp shadows. Fills the frame.
Full-length view of a woman in a sand linen dress and white sneakers walking down a wide whitewashed staircase towards the sea, seen from below, tall vertical composition with the subject centered.
Tan leather sandals and the hem of white linen trousers standing on sun-warmed terracotta tiles, low angle, bright midday light. Feet centered.

A tan leather weekender bag on the seat of a vintage train carriage, a folded white linen shirt and a paperback beside it, sunlit coastline and sea passing softly outside the window. Wide frame, bag centered.

Overhead view of an open canvas suitcase on a wooden floor, neatly packed with folded white and sand linen shirts, a sea blue swimsuit, sunglasses, a straw hat and a pair of leather sandals. Wide horizontal composition, suitcase centered, items in the middle band of the frame.

Three gift boxes wrapped in white paper with sea blue grosgrain ribbon and a sprig of fresh olive, on a white linen tablecloth beside a glass of iced lemon water. Wide horizontal composition, boxes centered in the middle band of the frame.
